epics.title: Moodle SSO Authentication and Role Mapping
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiologist or researcher signs in, I want to use my existing Moodle credentials and inherit my institutional roles, so that I can immediately access authorized strains without maintaining a separate account.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual user provisioning and role assignment time from 15 minutes to 0 minutes.
requirements: R1: The user initiates authentication using Moodle SSO via standard protocols (OAuth2/OIDC/LTI).
R2: The system automatically synchronizes and maps Moodle roles to internal Archive roles (Admin, Senior Researcher, Researcher).
R3: The system strictly restricts access to private pathogen strains and analytical reports based on the user's mapped Moodle departments and courses.
R4: If the Moodle LMS is unreachable, the user can successfully log in using an autonomous fallback mechanism.
R5: The user receives visible, non-destructive feedback of success, failure, or progress during the authentication flow.
R6: The SSO flow is fully operable on mobile devices to support field researchers.
R7: Initial test content consisting of mock Moodle profiles and course memberships is populated to allow immediate demonstration on a fresh install.

slices.title: Shared API Contract for Moodle SSO
slices.jtbd: When implementing the API contract for this epic, I want to define the shared endpoints for OAuth2 flows and role sync, so that frontend and backend build against a unified definition.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a frontend client requesting Moodle SSO config, When GET /api/auth/moodle/config is called, Then it returns the OAuth2 login URL.
Given a successful Moodle authentication, When POST /api/auth/moodle/callback receives the code, Then it returns the mapped user profile and session token.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce API integration mismatch defects from 15% to 0%.

slices.title: Pathogen Data Schema and Access Policies
slices.jtbd: When implementing data storage for this epic, I want to define the schema for mapping Moodle IDs to internal users and department policies, so that access restrictions are efficiently enforced.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a new user logging in via SSO, When their Moodle ID is not found, Then a new user record with mapped department policies is automatically inserted.
Given an existing user, When their Moodle roles change, Then the internal role assignments are updated atomically in the database.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce authorization query latency from 300ms to under 50ms.

slices.title: Backend Moodle SSO Integration and Fallback
slices.jtbd: When implementing backend logic for this epic, I want to execute the OAuth2 handshake, map roles, and provide a fallback, so that users are authenticated securely under all network conditions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid Moodle OAuth2 code, When the callback is processed, Then the backend maps the roles and issues a valid session.
Given Moodle is unreachable, When a user attempts autonomous fallback authentication with valid credentials, Then they are granted access to their authorized strains.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase SSO authentication backend success rate from 0% to >99.9%.

slices.title: Moodle SSO Frontend Implementation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the user interface for this epic, I want to provide a mobile-responsive login flow with clear error states, so that researchers can seamlessly enter the archive from any device.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated mobile user, When they load the login page, Then they see a prominently sized 'Login with Moodle' button meeting WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.
Given an SSO failure, When the user is redirected back, Then a visible error message explains the failure and offers the fallback login option.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase mobile login completion rate from 0% to >99%.

slices.title: QA: E2E and Integration Verification for Moodle SSO
slices.jtbd: When verifying the authentication flows for this epic, I want to test the SSO handshake and fallback mechanisms end-to-end, so that we guarantee the critical login path is unbroken.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an integration test suite, When the Moodle OAuth2 mock responds with valid roles, Then the user is successfully logged in and granted appropriate archive access.
Given an E2E test, When Moodle is simulated as offline, Then the user can successfully log in using the autonomous fallback mechanism.
Given a UI accessibility scan, When the login page is analyzed, Then zero WCAG 2.1 AA violations are found.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage of the authentication code paths from 0% to >95%.

epics.title: Measurement: Moodle SSO Adoption & Reliability
epics.jtbd: When the Moodle SSO feature is running in production, I want to measure the SSO adoption rate and the frequency of autonomous fallback usage, so that we can prove the system provides a robust and seamless login experience.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the visibility of SSO success versus fallback authentication from 0% to 100%.
requirements: R1: The system records a metric for the percentage of total logins completed via Moodle SSO versus fallback authentication.
R2: The system tracks and reports the success rate of the Moodle OAuth2/OIDC handshakes.

slices.title: Implement SSO Adoption and Reliability Telemetry
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for this epic, I want to emit metrics on Moodle SSO versus fallback login counts, so that the reliability of the SSO feature is measurable without a separate QA slice.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated session, When the user logs in via Moodle SSO, Then an 'sso_login_success' event is explicitly recorded in the metrics registry.
Given a fallback login, When the user successfully authenticates offline, Then a 'fallback_login_success' event is recorded.
Given the automated test suite, When telemetry paths are executed, Then it asserts that the correct metrics are emitted.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase metric coverage for authentication events from 0% to 100%.

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce support tickets for account recovery from 15% to 0%.
requirements: R1: Users who are locked out of their fallback or primary account must have a secure self-service recovery path.
R2: The recovery path must give visible feedback when a reset email or link is requested, ensuring the user is not left guessing.

slices.title: Self-Service Account Recovery Flow
slices.jtbd: When implementing account recovery for this epic, I want to provide a secure reset mechanism, so that locked-out users can regain access autonomously.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a locked-out user, When they request an account recovery, Then a secure, time-bound recovery link is generated and sent to their registered email.
Given a user interacting with the recovery UI, When they submit the request, Then they receive immediate, visible confirmation that the process has started.
Given the integration test suite, When the recovery flow is executed, Then the test asserts the token is generated and validated correctly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease average account recovery time from 24 hours to under 5 minutes.

epics.title: Data Subject Rights and Privacy Consent
epics.jtbd: When a user interacts with the archive, I want my personal data to be handled compliantly with options to export, erase, and control consent, so that the system adheres to GDPR and ePrivacy regulations.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce compliance violations and unfulfilled privacy requests from an unknown baseline to 0%.
requirements: R1: Users must be able to request an export of their own personal data.
R2: Users must be able to request the erasure of their personal data.
R3: An established consent platform must capture opt-in consent before any non-essential cookies or trackers load.

slices.title: Privacy Compliance Backend and Integration
slices.jtbd: When implementing privacy compliance for this epic, I want to expose endpoints for data export/erasure and integrate the consent platform, so that the product meets statutory privacy requirements.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated user, When they request data export, Then the system returns a structured payload of their personal information.
Given an authenticated user, When they request erasure, Then their PII is safely anonymized or deleted.
Given an unauthenticated visitor, When they land on the site, Then the established consent platform script is loaded.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase compliance endpoint success rate from 0% to 100%.

slices.title: QA: Verification of Data Subject Rights and Consent
slices.jtbd: When verifying privacy features for this epic, I want to ensure that export, erasure, and consent mechanisms function correctly end-to-end, so that compliance is guaranteed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a test user with personal data, When they invoke the erasure flow, Then all identifiable records are confirmed deleted from the database.
Given a new visitor session, When consent is refused, Then no non-essential cookies or trackers are loaded.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage of privacy workflows from 0% to >95%.

epics.title: System Backup and Verified Restore
epics.jtbd: When operating the Epidemiological Archive in production, I want regular automated backups and a proven restore process, so that critical pathogen data is not lost in the event of a failure.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the Recovery Time Objective (RTO) from unknown to under 1 hour.
requirements: R1: The system performs regular automated backups of the database and associated analytical reports.
R2: A complete restore from backup is practically performed and verified in a staging environment.

slices.title: Implement Automated Backup and Verified Restore
slices.jtbd: When implementing disaster recovery for this epic, I want to configure backups and test the restore process, so that the system data is safely protected against loss.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the production database, When the scheduled backup job runs, Then a complete snapshot is securely stored off-site.
Given a fresh environment, When the restore process is executed using the latest backup, Then all data is successfully recovered and verified intact.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase backup restore success rate from 0% to 100%.
